{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "own": "<id from her_items or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description", ""her_items" — her own items; an item of the description that is one of them gets its id in "own""]}, "description": "Fine-knit top: fitted, round neckline, long sleeves, hip length, soft blue-grey #8fa3b8, fine merino wool

Midi skirt: A-line with a slightly flowing hem, mid-calf length, deep navy #24304a, satin-finish crepe

Short jacket: straight cut, hip length, open front, charcoal #3a3f4a, textured wool tweed

Her white leather slingback flat sandals: open toe, low black sole, buckle strap at the heel, as they are, white leather

Small structured shoulder bag: top-handle with a thin chain strap, black #1c1c1f, smooth leather

Drop earrings: small and simple, silver tone, polished metal

Why this outfit works: The soft blue-grey knit echoes the colour of her eyes and sits well against her fair skin and dark hair, while the navy skirt gives the look an evening depth. The satin skirt catches artificial light, so it feels festive for a birthday party without becoming dressy. The textured jacket adds a neat layer for a cool autumn evening and can come off once the party warms up. The white sandals brighten the dark palette and keep the look light and easy to dance in.", "her_items": [{"id": "її-ф1", "name": "White leather slingback flat sandals"}]}
